pasos.nombre: Initial state has three columns and three cards in todo
Initial state has three cards in todo with correct data-id
Initial state has no cards in doing and done columns
Initial state shows correct counts in span elements
Click mas on first card moves it to doing and updates counts
After move, doing column has one card and todo has two, done remains zero
Click mas on second card moves it to doing until WIP limit reached
After two cards in doing, further mas clicks on todo cards do not change state and counts remain unchanged
Click menos on a card in doing moves it back to todo and updates counts
After moving back, doing has one card, todo has three, done remains zero
